verdict.rationale: Qodo documents configuration-as-code through a .pr_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level, which covers the versioned in-repo config core of the story. The portal remains the recommended configuration path, and the only profile-like feature is a set of display presets (Minimal/Standard/Comprehensive/Custom) not tied to the config file. Missing for 10: documented path filters, per-path review instructions, review profiles defined in the config file, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
